datasets.name: Population
datasets.description: Annual US population estimates from World Bank indicator SP.POP.TOTL. Includes separately labelled experimental baseline forecasts.

datasets.name: Gross domestic product
datasets.description: US annual GDP in current US dollars, World Bank indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CD. Nominal values are not inflation adjusted.

datasets.name: Airport inventory
datasets.description: Count of non-closed airport facilities by US state/territory in the current OurAirports inventory. Includes heliports and small airfields; not passenger traffic or annual history.
datasets.coverage: US states and unassigned facilities, current inventory

datasets.name: Origin–destination flows
datasets.description: Passenger and freight OD by mode, vehicle, commodity and industry. Requires source-specific integration.

datasets.name: Maritime AIS
datasets.description: Public historical AIS integrations and licensed real-time coverage remain planned.

datasets.name: Detailed census and economy
datasets.description: County and tract demographics, employment and industry integrations remain planned.

datasets.name: Road links and live operations
datasets.description: Link speeds, CCTV, counts and crowdsourced operations require additional connectors and rights review.
